error_bars: none; all three society replicates or their descriptive aggregates are shown

figures.name: fig01-tool-communication
figures.claim: Tools separate visibility, execution, functional contribution and collective coverage.
figures.caveat: Schematic of the implemented protocol, not additional observations.

figures.name: fig02-boids-mapping
figures.claim: The implemented triad is prompt guidance, with distinct measurable targets and limits.
figures.caveat: This figure describes v0.3.1; it does not show the earlier global-catalogue TF-IDF pilot.

figures.name: fig03-main-results
figures.claim: More publications adopt foreign tools, while final additional family coverage is zero.
figures.caveat: Points are societies, not cases. Three seeds per condition; lines join workload/topology seed matches. History is a union of versions.

figures.name: fig04-dynamics
figures.claim: Adoption and self-contained histories develop differently in the three seed matches.
figures.caveat: Top row uses original round-specific DEV checks; bottom uses already archived common fresh panel. No averages hide seed trajectories.

figures.name: fig05-author-provenance
figures.claim: Dependence supplements some author histories without adding collective categories.
figures.caveat: Own history requires an entirely same-author declared closure. It is not a measure of originality or understanding.

figures.name: fig06-code-and-budget
figures.claim: Short root packages do not imply proportionally lower total context or token use.
figures.caveat: AST size is static root size, excludes dependencies and is not effort or computational complexity. Input includes cached tokens; money is unverified.

figures.name: fig07-reliability
figures.claim: Observed failures concentrate in output contracts rather than providing a single cause for rule effects.
figures.caveat: Cases are correlated, declaration-conditioned and not independent replicates. A mismatched field is not automatically a common code cause.

figures.name: fig08-narrowing
figures.claim: Transient narrow declarations must be separated from sustained independent expertise.
figures.caveat: Selected because this is the only three-round same-author narrow declaration sequence; existing repair evidence only, no new execution.

figures.name: fig09-author-networks
figures.claim: The dependency structure involves more authors in Boids societies, with all seed graphs disclosed.
figures.caveat: Edges collapse versioned correct-execution pairs. This author projection may contain cycles although the version graph is acyclic; not the social ring.

figures.name: fig10-publication-breadth
figures.claim: Broad service offerings dominate every condition; four narrow declarations remain visible.
figures.caveat: Zero denotes an admitted publication with no fully passing family. A cross denotes skip or contract rejection; neither is missing data.
